messages:
amy_csm: Quick sync — we have an onboarding/auth ingestion problem that hit about ~120 tenants in EU between ~11:12-11:46 UTC. Need a short customer-facing status + RCA + remediation offer. Draft below, please review for tone and credit amount.

amy_csm: ```
Subject: Update: Onboarding interruptions for EU tenants (Mar 22)

Hi —

We’re reaching out to share an update on an onboarding interruption that affected some EU customers earlier today. Between 11:12–11:46 UTC we observed intermittent failures for tenant onboarding and schema ingest attempts.

What happened (short): a configuration propagation bug in our auth-sync service caused token validation errors for a subset of EU onboarding flows, resulting in 5xx responses and failed writes.

What we did: engineers rolled a targeted fix at 11:34 UTC and applied an additional safety rollback at 11:42 UTC to stop the bad propagation. We verified successful onboarding flows and backfilled incomplete ingest jobs where possible.

Current status: systems are stable and onboarding traffic has returned to normal. If you still see failures, please reply to this thread or open a support ticket and we’ll prioritize.

What we’re doing next: full RCA and permanent fix for the propagation logic; post-deploy will include additional integration tests and a rollout gating rule.

Customer help: if you experienced failed onboarding, we’ll offer one month of service credit and a scheduled 1:1 enablement session to replay any missed data. If you’re a renewal customer with impacted timelines, we’ll escalate your account for priority handling.

Thanks for your patience —
Amy from Redwood Inference Customer Success
```

ben_support: I like the tone. Small nit: change "schema ingest" to "indexing/ingest" — some customers use different terms. Also add a short link to status.redwood.ai for live updates.

diego_eng: Quick RCA addendum for the thread: root cause = config propagation TTL mis-evaluated when a config hot-swap coincided with a controlplane retry storm. That produced expired token handoffs for ~3% of EU onboarding requests. Fix rolled at 11:34 and prevented further propagation at 11:42. Backfill jobs started 11:50 and finished 12:30.

diego_eng: Long-term mitigations: 1) stricter propagation gating, 2) retry backoff tweaks, 3) post-propagation validation. ETA for permanent fix (PR+canary) = 3 days.

priya_ae: For renewals: we should offer account exec-managed extension instead of auto-credit for accounts flagged as renewal-risk. Can we add a line: "Renewal customers: contact your AE for a tailored remediation?"

amy_csm: Good call — I'll add that. For credits: ops, propose 1 month for all affected onboarding customers, and AE-managed extensions for renewals. Any objections?

ben_support: +1 to 1 month. Also add: "If you signed up with SSO/VPC and saw failures, we’ll coordinate a follow-up with engineering to re-run your onboarding flows."

priya_ae: +1. I’ll proactively reach out to the five renewal accounts I own after the comms go out.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20260322-1123 — severity: P2 — owners: eng-oncall, cs-ops.

amy_csm: Final question — timing. I can send the email at 14:00 UTC and post a short note in the support portal. If nothing else, I’ll post at 14:00. Reply here if you want edits before then.

diego_eng: No blockers from eng. Suggest adding the sentence: "We do not expect data loss; we are reprocessing incomplete ingests."

amy_csm: Added. Final draft ready. Sending at 14:00 UTC. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
